api.title: API settings
api.heading: Manage your APIs
api.subtitle: Save connections for different services. Enter a key only when adding an API.
api.emptyHint: Use the button below to add your first API.
api.selectHint: View or edit a connection, or add an API from the left panel.
api.newHint: Choose a protocol and save the connection.
api.editHint: Update the name, protocol or URL. The saved key is kept.
api.name: API name
api.baseHint: Enter the service’s base URL without an API key or query parameters.
api.keyHint: Input is hidden. Saved keys are never displayed.
api.noReveal: Keys cannot be viewed, copied or exported. To replace a key, delete and add the API again.
api.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” and its saved key? This cannot be undone.
api.storageNote: Keys are encrypted by the operating system
api.stageNote: Use saved APIs in model settings
error.API_STORAGE: API settings could not be read or saved. Check the data directory. Existing settings will not be overwritten automatically.
error.API_INPUT: Check the name, protocol, base URL and API key.
error.API_ENCRYPTION: System encryption is unavailable. A key cannot be added right now.
error.API_CONFLICT: The API list changed elsewhere. Select an API again before saving.
error.API_NOT_FOUND: This API was deleted. Refresh the list.
error.API_CAPACITY: The limit of 100 API configurations has been reached.
model.title: Model settings
model.heading: Manage available models
model.subtitle: Select models to enable them. Only one source can be enabled for each exact model ID.
model.addHint: Link a saved API and declare its reasoning capabilities.
model.idPlaceholder: Enter the provider’s exact model ID
model.levelsHint: Enter levels from lowest to highest, separated by commas. Verification uses the first value; levels are not sorted automatically.
model.deepseekHint: DeepSeek’s official API uses preset reasoning levels. Reasoning is disabled during verification.
model.saveHint: Save: store the configuration as unverified without sending a request.
model.verifyHint: Verify and save: send one small test request after confirmation.
model.verifiedSaved: Model verified and saved. Reported usage: {input} input / {output} output tokens.
model.chooseHint: Select a model on the left. Other sources with the same ID become unavailable until it is deselected. You can also add a model.
model.noApi: Add a source in API settings first.
model.enableHint: Enable the model from this source
model.duplicateDisabled: This model ID is enabled from another source. Deselect that source first.
model.sourceChanged: Source unavailable; remove and add again
model.footer: Verification checks whether one small test request is accepted
model.routingLater: Enabled models are listed for the main agent. Delegated calls also require a compatible billing adapter.
model.confirmCost: Verification uses a small number of tokens and may incur a charge.
model.confirmDetail: Only a short test input is sent, with no chat history or files. One request is made, without automatic retries. Failed or interrupted requests may still use tokens. Reasoning uses the first level you declared. Anthropic’s zero-output check only verifies request acceptance and model access.
error.MODEL_STORAGE: Model settings could not be read or saved. If verification was sent, it may have used tokens. It will not be retried automatically.
error.MODEL_INPUT: Check the source API, model ID and reasoning levels. Use lowercase English values for the levels.
error.MODEL_CONFLICT: The model list changed. Refresh it and try again.
error.MODEL_CAPACITY: The limit of 500 model configurations has been reached.
error.MODEL_DUPLICATE: This model ID is already configured for this API.
error.MODEL_REASONING: Declare reasoning effort levels, or select that reasoning effort cannot be configured.
error.MODEL_SOURCE: The source API was deleted, or its protocol or URL changed. Add the model again.
error.MODEL_ID_ENABLED: This model ID is already enabled from another source.
error.MODEL_BUSY: A verification is already in progress.
error.MODEL_VERIFY_UNKNOWN: The verification outcome is unknown and may have used tokens. The model was not saved; no automatic retry was made.
error.MODEL_VERIFY_HTTP: The service rejected verification. The model was not saved; no automatic retry was made.
error.MODEL_VERIFY_RESPONSE: The response did not match the selected protocol. The model was not saved.
error.MODEL_VERIFY_CREDENTIAL: The source key is currently unavailable. Verification could not be completed.
pricing.fileInvalid: The {provider} price file is invalid. New calls are paused until it is corrected and saved.
pricing.fileExpired: The {provider} price file expired. Review the rates and update the expiry date.
error.UI_LOCALE: This interface language is not available.
error.UI_PREFERENCES: The language preference could not be saved. Check that the data directory is writable.
